name: Content Creator

sections.daily_work: Create videos, blog posts, podcasts, or social media content. Research topics, write scripts, film and edit. Engage with audience. Manage brand deals and sponsorships. Analyze performance.
sections.learning: Video editing (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci Resolve), writing and storytelling, social media strategy, SEO, audience analytics, lighting and audio basics, personal branding.
sections.pay: Varies enormously. Most creators start earning nothing. Growing channels earn $500-$5,000/month. Successful creators can earn $10,000-$100,000+/month. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Start creating on any platform (YouTube, TikTok, blog, podcast), build an audience organically, learn editing through free tutorials, collaborate with other creators, pursue brand deals.

try_in_real_life: Create and post 3 short videos or blog posts on a topic you love
Learn basic video editing with a free tool (CapCut or DaVinci Resolve)
Study 3 creators you admire: what makes their content work?
Research the YouTube Partner Program and monetization requirements
sources: Creator economy reports (SignalFire, Linktree); platform analytics data
